Package ke.ric.renderer.api

Record Class RenderSettings

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
ke.ric.renderer.api.RenderSettings
Record Components:
version - contract version; v1 requires 1
profile - stable quality intent that must be advertised by capabilities
width - output width in pixels
height - output height in pixels
attachments - requested optional per-pixel attachments
nativeMemoryLimitBytes - caller ceiling for native memory used by this job
workers - requested bounded native worker count
timeout - end-to-end render deadline starting at task creation
public record RenderSettings(int version, RenderSettings.Profile profile, int width, int height, Set<Attachment> attachments, long nativeMemoryLimitBytes, int workers, Duration timeout) extends Record
Immutable output, quality, attachment, memory, worker, and deadline settings for a render.
